claim: Memory splits what Lyric meets by what it is about: kinds and what the world holds go to the one door; the speaker, their particulars and names the world does not hold go to their context, personal or work; a telling holding both is split; what is too weakly said, or did not read, is held nowhere.
hypothesis: A case landing anywhere but where the table above says -- a person's thing in the world, a kind kept only for the person, work filed as personal, a weak telling held -- would fail here.

checks.label: the run is in the sandbox
a particular the world holds, told: the world's
a name the world does not hold: theirs, personal, and the world does not even name it
the speaker, of themselves: kept under them, personal
a name, told at work: the organization's Work Context, not the person's
both in one telling: split, the kind to the world and the name to them
a rule of kinds: a rule of the world's, and none in their context
a rule of their particular: theirs, and none in the world
too weakly said: held nowhere, and why is said
a page found by research: the world's
a thing in their picture, named: theirs
a thing Lyric saw itself, named: the world's
Lyric's own observation of its host: the world's
their device, as it reports itself: theirs
a sentence that did not read: no fact anywhere, remembered as theirs

notes: case: a kind, told: "A wugxqrxvp is a bird." -> world
case: a particular the world holds, told: "Lumeriaxqrxvp is a port." (the world holds Lumeriaxqrxvp as a city) -> world
case: a name the world does not hold: "Avaxqrxvp is a dancer." -> personal
case: the speaker, of themselves: "I am a teacher." -> speaker
case: a name, told at work: "Northwindxqrxvp VPN is a network." through the work context -> work:split01-org-xqrxvp
case: their particular thing: "My printer is broken." (printerxqrxvp_1, theirs) -> personal
case: both in one telling: "A quillxqrxvp is a bird and Avaxqrxvp is happy." -> world + personal
case: a rule of kinds: "If a wugxqrxvp is hungry, a wugxqrxvp is loud." -> world rule
case: a rule of their particular: "If my printer is hot, my printer is loud." -> personal rule
case: too weakly said: "A blorfxqrxvp is a bird.", at quality 0.2 -> nothing
case: a page found by research: zorbitexqrxvp is a mineral, on example.org -> world
case: a thing in their picture, named: blobxqrxvp_p in their photo named a printer -> personal
case: a thing Lyric saw itself, named: blobxqrxvp_l Lyric saw named a printer -> world
case: Lyric's own observation of its host: hostxqrxvp is a machine -> world
case: their device, as it reports itself: phonexqrxvp, an iPhone, allows camera -> personal
case: a sentence that did not read: "Glorpxqrxvp frabbed the snoo." -> nothing (remembered as theirs)
